message.reasoning:
The user says: "start Docker on window using docker start." They want to start Docker on Windows using docker start. But docker start is used to start containers, not the Docker daemon. To start Docker service, you need to start the Docker Desktop or the Docker Engine service. On Windows, you can use `net start com.docker.service` or `Start-Service -Name com.docker.service` in PowerShell. Or use `docker-machine start default`. But the user might want to start Docker Desktop. The correct command: `Start-Service -Name com.docker.service` or `net start com.docker.service`. Or if using Docker Desktop, you can start it via `& "C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\Docker Desktop.exe"`. But the user specifically says "using docker start". That is wrong. ```

```
net start com.docker.service
```

Then call it. Or use PowerShell: `powershell -Command "Start-Service -Name com.docker.service"`.
